about: Field calibrations for the heat-exchange tool, newest first. status: 'usable' (UA and C trusted; offered in step 4), 'provisional' (fitted but not yet trusted), 'not usable' (event recorded for what it shows, no UA/C). Temperatures are raw VESPER readings unless stated.

entries.event: Inlet fan stopped by warm weather (10:33 EST); recirculation fan stayed at 20%
entries.data: TORPOR / ThingSpeak 3535045+3535049, 1-min, raw readings, 2026-11-15 06:00 to 2026-11-16 14:46 EST; HOBO comparison from the Nov 12 VESPER-vs-HOBO check
observations: Raw readings overnight with the inlet fan at 80%: outside ~4.4 °C, middle of the chamber (S2/S3) ~7.0 °C, rear (S4/S5) ~8.8 °C.

The apparent middle-to-rear gradient (~1.8 °C) is mostly sensor bias, not air temperature. VESPER sensors read ~2 °C high in still air and about right in moving air (Nov 12 comparison with HOBOs). S4/S5 sit out of the airflow; the HOBO beside S4 (ICU_back) cooled 7.9 to 6.8 °C after the fans started, like the middle.
After the inlet stopped (10:33 EST), S2/S3 rose ~0.5 °C in the first hour and then levelled off; S4/S5 rose ~0.2 °C in 4 h.
The S2/S3 rise cannot be separated from the still-air bias, which should appear as airflow over those sensors drops. Check against HOBO 'middle' and 'ICU_back' at the next download.
caveats: Recirculation fan ran throughout, so this is not passive recovery.
No clean Initial (fan-on, room cooling) window, so C cannot be estimated.
VESPER sensor bias depends on airflow, so no fixed correction is valid across a fan on/off change. Use HOBO temperatures for fits until the cause is resolved.
entries.wanted: HOBO data for the same period, and a clean trial: inlet and recirculation fans both off for 12 h or more after a long cold run (to be arranged with the TORPOR engineering team).
